text: 153/01 review (solo): record-recall reuses the existing feedback.recorded event so it publishes through the existing cascade; the acceptor census sweep observations:feedback-recorded (packages/work/src/acceptor/observations.mjs) counts that event by name, so recall observations will be counted as recorded feedback. The census is a floor so it over-counts rather than under-counts, but the label is wrong. Route: recorded finding (a payload-level exclusion on recallId changes census semantics and is not cheaper than the driver). Also: the remote-only owner row is covered by test/command/work-memory-command.test.mjs (cache fixture), not by the CLI feature, because a cache-only item cannot be fabricated through the spawned CLI fixture.

153/02 build (solo): the story's declared files: omit three paths the build had to touch — test/arch/testing/acd-source-directory-budget.test.mjs (four rows rose: packages/knowledge/test 13->14, test/integration/features 10->11, steps 11->12, test/arch/memory 23->24, each with its reason), test/arch/memory/acd-learning-edge-reaches-every-cut.test.mjs (FF-12405 leg 4 pins the verb vocabulary, which now includes recurrence) and the milestone RESEARCH.md (the @manual scenario requires the calibration basis there). Same class as 140/R1: a new test file is a budget change. Route: recorded finding (refine repair of the census). Raised by: developer

153/02 build (solo): the recurrence matcher is blind to two kinds of recurrence, both measured in RESEARCH.md. (1) A lesson that restates an earlier one in different words — the five lessons 148/R1 names score 0.044-0.083, 152/R3 vs 140/R1 0.019 — is not detectable by shared vocabulary, so Recurs for the files:-census family stays the author's manual act. (2) A lesson written as free prose rather than labelled What happened/Why/Lesson fields is indexed by its title alone (146/R1 indexes 79 characters), so the matcher scores only what the index holds; fixing that changes ranking text, which ADR-002 freezes. Route: recorded finding (the second needs a contract amendment to ADR-002 or a parser story). Raised by: developer

153/02 gate (inherited, not 153/02's): at the branch base the budget row packages/execution/src is red (26 children against a ceiling of 24, from 154/156), which reds six FF-11904/138-00 cases; arch/124/02 FF-12405 leg 9 and bundle/manifest + 149/02 are red on a manifest hash for .agents/skills/aof-add-chore/SKILL.md against the modified .aof/aof.lock.json; arch/15 ADR-005 drive-review answers unknown-flag where runtime-asset-missing is expected. None is touched by the 153/02 diff. Route: recorded finding. Raised by: developer

153/05 build (solo): the declared files: omit paths the build had to touch — packages/work/src/memory-accounting.mjs (readLedgerText returns each observation's line, buildAccounting can cite its rows with evidence:true, the stream walk narrows to selected items), packages/work/src/memory-vocabulary.mjs (promotionPointers, the one reader of every destination a Promoted to value names), packages/work/src/tune/provenance.mjs (documentDeclarations looked a declared id's form up by name-plus-hyphen, so a retrospective lesson's hyphenless R13 was never declared and no qualified lesson reference could resolve), packages/work/test/memory-vocabulary.suite.mjs and memory-accounting.suite.mjs (their new exports' cases) and test/arch/testing/acd-source-directory-budget.test.mjs (integration features 12->13, steps 13->14, each with its reason). Same class as 153/02 and 153/03. Route: recorded finding (refine repair of the census). Raised by: developer

153/05 build (solo): a candidate made of several lessons promoted to one prompt quotes only its canonical lesson (the one the most later lessons repeat, then the earliest). Once that block is in force the next run reports already-in-force and the other lessons' corrections are never proposed. The spec's one-block-per-canonical-ref wording (E3, E4) settles the shape, so extending it to one block per promoted lesson is a contract amendment. Also: premise-moved and the ordinal-acceptor coexistence are bound in test/planning/tune-proposal.test.mjs and tune-command.test.mjs, not in memory-tune-prompt.feature, because the CLI cannot present a pre-formed patch or an injected acceptor; the promotion destination is no longer cited as lesson evidence (a missing target must report as target-unreadable, not as an unresolvable citation). Route: recorded finding. Raised by: developer
